visual.prompt: A tall glass office building of a fund house at midday, people in office wear walking in, a giant glowing jar of coins visible through the glass lobby, slightly ominous tone

scenes.vo: Lekin usi list mein ek naam aur tha, Nippon Life India AMC.

scenes.label: what happened

visual.prompt: Inside a fund house office, rows of desks with screens showing rising and falling lines, a stream of small coins flowing in from many tiny houses drawn along the wall, busy daytime

scenes.vo: AMC yaani asset management company, woh company jo aapke SIP ka paisa chalati hai.

visual.prompt: A group of analysts around a conference table looking at a huge stack of currency bundles growing on the table, impressed faces, evening light through office blinds
